cited.basis: Article 2 inserts a new §3 into c. 102 and renumbers the paragraph that stood there as §4, so the paragraph that was §3 is no longer §3.
Article 2 prints the new §3 -- patriarchs and eparchial bishops still in office excepted, a member who has completed his eightieth year -- and renumbers the former §3 as §4. [Delivery, lines 51-53.]
